Deploy the project at each API after setting sourceApiVersion and both class
apiVersion values to that API. Assign JuniperMarkProbe to the scratch user.
Run anonymous.apex via Execute Anonymous and JuniperUpsertProbeTest via the
Apex test runner at the same API. The native capture named the wrapper method
observeRows and used the ROAD563_UPSERT| observation prefix. The replay uses
observe and OBS| to match the shared conformance runner. Both routes invoke
the same probe body.

NEIGHBOR PROBES
Exact-length and padded exact-length keys insert successfully. The
supplementary character contributes two UTF-16 units. An oversized key takes
priority over another oversized field and fails even with the record's
allowFieldTruncation option set. A long non-key field on the explicit
selector's insert path and the long field with implicit Id matching keep
STRING_TOO_LONG and isCreated=true. The R133 missing-required Account
control keeps isCreated=true on the insert path. Explicit Id selection,
ID-lookup fields and updates by populated record Id were outside this capture.
